about: The map of IPMA's open data API: every endpoint IPMA documents at https://api.ipma.pt/ and every file its directory lists under /open-data/, with the address, the format, each field's meaning and unit, how often IPMA says it changes, and what the documentation does not say. Meanings are our English for IPMA's Portuguese; where a field carries 'ipma', that is IPMA's own wording, quoted. 'doc_differs' marks a field whose name in the responses is not the name in the documentation. What we observed (hashes, sizes, times, changes) is in latest.json, reads.json and changes/.
label: fact: read from IPMA's documentation and responses; "not_documented" and "observed_note" are our observations of what was and was not there

times.ipma_says: As previsões são apresentadas em horas UTC. No continente e na Região Autónoma da Madeira a hora legal é igual à UTC, no horário de inverno.
times.note: No time in any response carries a zone, except the climate CSVs (+00:00).

general.beyond: www.ipma.pt itself reads other addresses under https://api.ipma.pt/public-data/ (hourly forecasts, for example). They are not documented, the /public-data/ path is outside the open-data documentation and its terms for reuse are not stated: not mapped here until Dinis says so.

fields.meaning: the warning area (a district, an island group, or a part of Madeira)

fields.name: awarenessTypeName
fields.ipma: parâmetro do aviso (e.g. "Trovoada", "Agitação Marítima", "Precipitação", "Vento", "Nevoeiro", "Neve", "Tempo Frio", "Tempo Quente")

fields.meaning: the level: green, yellow, orange, red
fields.ipma: só existem avisos para níveis diferentes de "green"

fields.name: text
fields.ipma: preenchido apenas quando o aviso é amarelo, laranja ou vermelho

cadence.observed: see latest.json and changes/warnings.json: the Last-Modified header moves when IPMA rewrites the file

endpoints.ipma_says: Para mais informações sobre os Avisos Meteorológicos consulte o nosso Guia.
not_documented: no time of issue: a row does not say when the warning was issued or changed (the file's Last-Modified header is the nearest thing)
the time zone of startTime and endTime (the documentation says forecasts are in UTC; for warnings it says nothing)
the areas MCN, MRM (in the feed) are in no id table: distrits-islands.json has MCS and MPS only
no identifier for a warning: a changed warning is a different row, not an update of the same one
